    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
          coverage: none
      - name: Validate the Composer manifest and lock file
        run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        if: matrix.php == '8.1' || matrix.php == '8.2' || matrix.php == '8.3'
        run: composer check-platform-reqs
      - name: Check library requirements outside the locked ParaTest PHP range
        if: matrix.php == '8.4' || matrix.php == '8.5'
        run: composer check-platform-reqs --no-dev
      - name: Run the tests in parallel
        run: composer test

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.3'
          extensions: dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
          coverage: none
      - name: Validate the Composer manifest and lock file
        run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true

        run: composer phpstan
      - name: Check PHP compatibility

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240

          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: composer check-platform-reqs
      - name: Run the benchmarks
        run: composer bench

    name: Mutation Testing
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
          extensions: ctype, date, dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
          coverage: pcov
          tools: infection:0.35.4
          ini-values: memory_limit=1G
      - name: Validate the Composer manifest and lock file
        run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
      - name: Install package dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-faker
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: |
          composer check-platform-reqs --no-dev
          infection --version
      - name: Mutation testing on changed lines
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: >-
          php -d memory_limit=4G "$(command -v infection)"
          --configuration=infection.json5
          --threads=4
          --only-covering-test-cases
          --git-diff-lines
          --git-diff-base="origin/${GITHUB_BASE_REF}"
          --ignore-msi-with-no-mutations
          --min-msi=85
          --min-covered-msi=85
          --no-progress
          --logger-github
      - name: Mutation testing on the whole source tree
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: >-
          php -d memory_limit=4G "$(command -v infection)"
          --configuration=infection.json5
          --threads=4
          --only-covering-test-cases
          --no-progress
          --logger-github
      - name: Reject skipped whole-tree mutants
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: |
          php -d memory_limit=4G -r '
            $report = json_decode(file_get_contents("build/infection/infection.json"), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            if ($report["stats"]["skippedCount"] !== 0) {
                fwrite(STDERR, "Infection skipped mutants before execution; review the timeout against test durations.\n");
                exit(1);
            }
          '
      - name: Upload mutation reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: sql-faker-infection
          path: packages/sql-faker/build/infection/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
name: Split Monorepo

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    tags:
      - 'v*'

jobs:
  split:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        package:
          - local_path: ztd-query-core
            split_repository: ztd-query-core
          - local_path: sql-faker
            split_repository: sql-faker
          - local_path: sql-fixture
            split_repository: sql-fixture
          - local_path: ztd-query-mysql
            split_repository: ztd-query-mysql
          - local_path: ztd-query-postgres
            split_repository: ztd-query-postgres
          - local_path: ztd-query-sqlite
            split_repository: ztd-query-sqlite
          - local_path: ztd-query-pdo-adapter
            split_repository: ztd-query-pdo-adapter
          - local_path: ztd-query-mysqli-adapter
            split_repository: ztd-query-mysqli-adapter

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Determine version constraint
        id: version
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
        run: |
          TAG="${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/v}"
          MAJOR="${TAG%%.*}"
          MINOR="${TAG#*.}"
          MINOR="${MINOR%%.*}"
          echo "constraint=^${MAJOR}.${MINOR}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "tag=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Transform composer.json
        run: |
          FILE="packages/${{ matrix.package.local_path }}/composer.json"
          CONSTRAINT="${{ steps.version.outputs.constraint }}"

          if [ -n "$CONSTRAINT" ]; then
            jq --arg v "$CONSTRAINT" '
              (if .repositories then .repositories |= [.[] | select(.type == "path" | not)] else . end) |
              (if .repositories == [] then del(.repositories) else . end) |
              (if ."require-dev"."k-kinzal/phpstan-custom-rules" then del(."require-dev"."k-kinzal/phpstan-custom-rules") else . end) |
              (if ."autoload-dev"."psr-4" then
                ."autoload-dev"."psr-4" |= with_entries(
                  if (.value | type) == "array" then
                    .value |= [.[] | select(startswith("../") | not)] |
                    if (.value | length) == 1 then .value = .value[0] else . end
                  else . end
                )
              else . end) |
              .require |= with_entries(
                if (.key | startswith("k-kinzal/")) and .value == "@dev" then .value = $v else . end
              ) |
              ."require-dev" |= with_entries(
                if (.key | startswith("k-kinzal/")) and .value == "@dev" then .value = $v else . end
              )
            ' "$FILE" > "${FILE}.tmp" && mv "${FILE}.tmp" "$FILE"
          else
            jq '
              (if .repositories then .repositories |= [.[] | select(.type == "path" | not)] else . end) |
              (if .repositories == [] then del(.repositories) else . end) |
              (if ."require-dev"."k-kinzal/phpstan-custom-rules" then del(."require-dev"."k-kinzal/phpstan-custom-rules") else . end) |
              (if ."autoload-dev"."psr-4" then
                ."autoload-dev"."psr-4" |= with_entries(
                  if (.value | type) == "array" then
                    .value |= [.[] | select(startswith("../") | not)] |
                    if (.value | length) == 1 then .value = .value[0] else . end
                  else . end
                )
              else . end)
            ' "$FILE" > "${FILE}.tmp" && mv "${FILE}.tmp" "$FILE"
          fi

      - uses: danharrin/monorepo-split-github-action@v2.3.0
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.ACCESS_TOKEN }}
        with:
          package_directory: packages/${{ matrix.package.local_path }}
          repository_organization: k-kinzal
          repository_name: ${{ matrix.package.split_repository }}
          user_name: k-kinzal
          user_email: k-kinzal@users.noreply.github.com
          tag: ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}

on:

    - name: Faker

        - type: classLike

  ruleset:

name: Split Monorepo

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    tags:
      - 'v*'

jobs:
  split:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        package:
          - local_path: ztd-query-core
            split_repository: ztd-query-core
          - local_path: sql-faker
            split_repository: sql-faker
          - local_path: sql-fixture
            split_repository: sql-fixture
          - local_path: ztd-query-mysql
            split_repository: ztd-query-mysql
          - local_path: ztd-query-postgres
            split_repository: ztd-query-postgres
          - local_path: ztd-query-sqlite
            split_repository: ztd-query-sqlite
          - local_path: ztd-query-pdo-adapter
            split_repository: ztd-query-pdo-adapter
          - local_path: ztd-query-mysqli-adapter
            split_repository: ztd-query-mysqli-adapter

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Determine version constraint
        id: version
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
        run: |
          TAG="${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/v}"
          MAJOR="${TAG%%.*}"
          MINOR="${TAG#*.}"
          MINOR="${MINOR%%.*}"
          echo "constraint=^${MAJOR}.${MINOR}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "tag=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Transform composer.json
        run: |
          FILE="packages/${{ matrix.package.local_path }}/composer.json"
          CONSTRAINT="${{ steps.version.outputs.constraint }}"

          if [ -n "$CONSTRAINT" ]; then
            jq --arg v "$CONSTRAINT" '
              (if .repositories then .repositories |= [.[] | select(.type == "path" | not)] else . end) |
              (if .repositories == [] then del(.repositories) else . end) |
              (if ."require-dev"."k-kinzal/phpstan-custom-rules" then del(."require-dev"."k-kinzal/phpstan-custom-rules") else . end) |
              (if ."autoload-dev"."psr-4" then
                ."autoload-dev"."psr-4" |= with_entries(
                  if (.value | type) == "array" then
                    .value |= [.[] | select(startswith("../") | not)] |
                    if (.value | length) == 1 then .value = .value[0] else . end
                  else . end
                )
              else . end) |
              .require |= with_entries(
                if (.key | startswith("k-kinzal/")) and .value == "@dev" then .value = $v else . end
              ) |
              ."require-dev" |= with_entries(
                if (.key | startswith("k-kinzal/")) and .value == "@dev" then .value = $v else . end
              )
            ' "$FILE" > "${FILE}.tmp" && mv "${FILE}.tmp" "$FILE"
          else
            jq '
              (if .repositories then .repositories |= [.[] | select(.type == "path" | not)] else . end) |
              (if .repositories == [] then del(.repositories) else . end) |
              (if ."require-dev"."k-kinzal/phpstan-custom-rules" then del(."require-dev"."k-kinzal/phpstan-custom-rules") else . end) |
              (if ."autoload-dev"."psr-4" then
                ."autoload-dev"."psr-4" |= with_entries(
                  if (.value | type) == "array" then
                    .value |= [.[] | select(startswith("../") | not)] |
                    if (.value | length) == 1 then .value = .value[0] else . end
                  else . end
                )
              else . end)
            ' "$FILE" > "${FILE}.tmp" && mv "${FILE}.tmp" "$FILE"
          fi

      - uses: danharrin/monorepo-split-github-action@v2.3.0
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.ACCESS_TOKEN }}
        with:
          package_directory: packages/${{ matrix.package.local_path }}
          repository_organization: k-kinzal
          repository_name: ${{ matrix.package.split_repository }}
          user_name: k-kinzal
          user_email: k-kinzal@users.noreply.github.com
          tag: ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}

# NOTE: You do not have permission to overwrite this file. Please ask a human operator to perform the changes for you.
#
# Layers describe stages of SQL generation. Subdirectories such as Plan, Token,
# Derivation, Value, Lexeme and Output are implementation details within a stage.
# PHPDoc aliases are assigned to the same stage as their declaring classes.
deptrac:
  paths:
    - ./src
  analyser:
    types:
      - class
      - use
  layers:
    # Compiled syntax definitions and the releases they describe.
    - name: Grammar
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Grammar/'
    # Reads upstream grammar sources and publishes compiled artifacts.
    - name: Compiler
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Compiler/'
    # Plans, derives, rewrites, realizes and measures generated SQL.
    - name: Generation
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Generation/'
        - type: classLike
          value: '^SqlFaker\\Generation\\Plan\\TRequiresNonEmpty$'
        - type: classLike
          value: '^SqlFaker\\Generation\\Coverage\\(Measurement|Trace|Checkpoint|Snapshot|History|Entry|Rewrite)$'
    # Concrete stages depend on the corresponding shared concepts.
    - name: MySqlGrammar
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/MySql/Grammar/'
    - name: MySqlGeneration
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/MySql/Generation/'
    - name: PostgreSqlGrammar
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/PostgreSql/Grammar/'
    - name: PostgreSqlGeneration
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/PostgreSql/Generation/'
        - type: classLike
          value: '^SqlFaker\\PostgreSql\\Generation\\Lookahead\\LookaheadRule$'
    - name: SqliteGrammar
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Sqlite/Grammar/'
    - name: SqliteGeneration
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Sqlite/Generation/'
    # Public entry points, statement aliases and dialect composition.
    - name: Provider
      collectors:
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/[^/]+Provider\.php$'
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/Provider/'
        - type: directory
          value: 'src/(MySql|PostgreSql|Sqlite)/StatementType\.php$'
        - type: classLike
          value: '^SqlFaker\\(MySql|PostgreSql|Sqlite)\\StatementType$'
    - name: Faker
      collectors:
        - type: classLike
          value: '^Faker\\.*'
  ruleset:
    Grammar: []
    Compiler: [Grammar]
    Generation: [Grammar, Faker]
    MySqlGrammar: [Grammar]
    MySqlGeneration: [Grammar, Generation, MySqlGrammar, Faker]
    PostgreSqlGrammar: [Grammar]
    PostgreSqlGeneration: [Grammar, Generation, PostgreSqlGrammar, Faker]
    SqliteGrammar: [Grammar]
    SqliteGeneration: [Grammar, Generation, SqliteGrammar, Faker]
    Provider: [Grammar, Generation, MySqlGrammar, MySqlGeneration, PostgreSqlGrammar, PostgreSqlGeneration, SqliteGrammar, SqliteGeneration, Faker]
    Faker: []

# Database Containers

Shared Testcontainers definitions for integration and fuzz tests in this monorepo.
Requires PHP 8.1+, Docker, and the PDO driver for the database being started.
The MySQLi helper also requires `ext-mysqli`.

Add `k-kinzal/container: @dev` to the consuming package's `require-dev` and
`{"type": "path", "url": "../container"}` to its Composer repositories.

## Definitions

The profiles preserve the existing images, credentials, database names, wait
strategies, and container lifecycle settings.

| Namespace | Definitions | Behavior |
|-----------|-------------|----------|
| `Container\Fuzz` | `MySql56Container`, `MySql57Container`, `MySql80Container`, `MySql81Container`, `MySql82Container`, `MySql83Container`, `MySql84Container`, `MySql90Container`, `MySql91Container`, `PostgreSqlContainer` | Pinned MySQL releases and PostgreSQL 17.2; disposable containers for SQL grammar fuzzing |
| `Container\Reusable` | `MySql80Container`, `MySql84Container`, `PostgreSqlContainer` | MySQL 8.0.44 / 8.4.7 and PostgreSQL 16; reused within an adapter fuzzing process |
| `Container\Fixture` | `MySql84Container` | MySQL 8.4.7 from Oracle's registry with the `test` database initialized |
| `Container\Pdo` | `MySqlContainer`, `PostgreSqlContainer` | MySQL 8.0 and PostgreSQL 16; cached PDO connection and isolated database/schema helpers |
| `Container\Mysqli` | `MySqlContainer` | MySQL 8.0; cached MySQLi connection and isolated database helper |

MySQL containers use `root` / `root`. PostgreSQL containers use `test` / `test`,
with `fuzz_test` for fuzzing and `ztd_test` for integration tests.
`Container\PostgreSqlDSN` supplies the shared PostgreSQL wait-strategy DSN.

## Usage

```php
use Container\Fuzz\MySql80Container;
use Testcontainers\Testcontainers;

$instance = Testcontainers::run(MySql80Container::class);
$host = $instance->getHost();
$port = $instance->getMappedPort(3306);
$grammarVersion = MySql80Container::getGrammarVersion();
```

```php
use Container\Pdo\MySqlContainer;
use Container\Pdo\PostgreSqlContainer;

[$database, $mysql] = MySqlContainer::createTestDatabase();
[$schema, $postgres] = PostgreSqlContainer::createTestSchema();
```

Use `Container\Mysqli\MySqlContainer::createTestDatabase()` for a MySQLi connection.
Each helper call selects a fresh database or schema; the connection is reused
within the process. Testcontainers stops the containers at process shutdown.

## Development

```bash
composer install
composer test:unit
composer test:integration
composer lint
```

Integration tests require Docker and `pdo_mysql`, `pdo_pgsql`, and `mysqli`.

    branches: [main]

      - run: composer test:unit

      - uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2

          coverage: none

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Unit;

use Container\PostgreSqlDSN;
use LogicException;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\CoversClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

#[CoversClass(PostgreSqlDSN::class)]
final class PostgreSqlDSNTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testRequiresHostBeforeRendering(): void
    {
        $this->expectException(LogicException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Host is required');

        (new PostgreSqlDSN())->withPort(5432)->withDbname('test')->toString();
    }

    public function testRendersHostWithoutOptionalConnectionSettings(): void
    {
        $dsn = (new PostgreSqlDSN())->withHost('127.0.0.1');

        self::assertSame('pgsql:host=127.0.0.1;', $dsn->toString());
        self::assertNull($dsn->getPort());
        self::assertTrue($dsn->requiresHostPort());
    }

    public function testAcceptsMappedEndpointAfterDatabaseIsConfigured(): void
    {
        $dsn = (new PostgreSqlDSN())->withDbname('fuzz_test');
        self::assertNull($dsn->getHost());

        $dsn->withHost('127.0.0.1')->withPort(15432);

        self::assertSame('127.0.0.1', $dsn->getHost());
        self::assertSame(15432, $dsn->getPort());
        self::assertSame('pgsql:host=127.0.0.1;port=15432;dbname=fuzz_test;', (string) $dsn);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Integration;

use Container\Mysqli\MySqlContainer as MysqliContainer;
use Container\Pdo\MySqlContainer;
use Container\Pdo\PostgreSqlContainer;
use mysqli_result;
use PDOStatement;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\CoversClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

#[CoversClass(MySqlContainer::class)]
#[CoversClass(MysqliContainer::class)]
#[CoversClass(PostgreSqlContainer::class)]
final class TestDatabaseTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testPdoMySqlReusesConnectionWithIsolatedDatabases(): void
    {
        [$firstDatabase, $firstConnection] = MySqlContainer::createTestDatabase();
        $firstConnection->exec('CREATE TABLE isolation_probe (id INT)');

        [$secondDatabase, $secondConnection] = MySqlContainer::createTestDatabase();
        $secondConnection->exec('CREATE TABLE isolation_probe (id INT)');

        self::assertNotSame($firstDatabase, $secondDatabase);
        self::assertSame($firstConnection, $secondConnection);
        $result = $secondConnection->query('SELECT DATABASE()');
        self::assertInstanceOf(PDOStatement::class, $result);
        self::assertSame($secondDatabase, $result->fetchColumn());
    }

    public function testMysqliReusesConnectionWithIsolatedDatabases(): void
    {
        [$firstDatabase, $firstConnection] = MysqliContainer::createTestDatabase();
        $firstConnection->query('CREATE TABLE isolation_probe (id INT)');

        [$secondDatabase, $secondConnection] = MysqliContainer::createTestDatabase();
        $secondConnection->query('CREATE TABLE isolation_probe (id INT)');

        self::assertNotSame($firstDatabase, $secondDatabase);
        self::assertSame($firstConnection, $secondConnection);
        $result = $secondConnection->query('SELECT DATABASE()');
        self::assertInstanceOf(mysqli_result::class, $result);
        self::assertSame([$secondDatabase], $result->fetch_row());
    }

    public function testPostgreSqlReusesConnectionWithIsolatedSchemas(): void
    {
        [$firstSchema, $firstConnection] = PostgreSqlContainer::createTestSchema();
        $firstConnection->exec('CREATE TABLE isolation_probe (id INT)');

        [$secondSchema, $secondConnection] = PostgreSqlContainer::createTestSchema();
        $secondConnection->exec('CREATE TABLE isolation_probe (id INT)');

        self::assertNotSame($firstSchema, $secondSchema);
        self::assertSame($firstConnection, $secondConnection);
        $result = $secondConnection->query('SELECT current_schema()');
        self::assertInstanceOf(PDOStatement::class, $result);
        self::assertSame($secondSchema, $result->fetchColumn());
    }

## Skills
A skill is a set of local instructions to follow that is stored in a `SKILL.md` file. Below is the list of skills that can be used. Each entry includes a name, description, and a short path that can be expanded into an absolute path using the skill roots table.
### Skill roots
- `r0` = `/Users/ab/.codex/skills`
- `r1` = `/Users/ab/.agents/skills`
- `r2` = `/Users/ab/.codex/skills/.system`
- `r3` = `/Users/ab/.codex/plugins/cache/openai-bundled`
- `r4` = `/Users/ab/.codex/plugins/cache/openai-bundled/sites/0.1.37/skills`
- `r5` = `/Users/ab/.codex/plugins/cache/openai-primary-runtime`
- `r6` = `/Users/ab/.codex/plugins/cache/openai-primary-runtime/spreadsheets/26.813.12317/skills`
### Available skills
- imagegen: Generate or edit raster images when the task benefits from AI-created bitmap visuals such as photos, illustrations, textures, sprites, mockups, or transparent-background cutouts. Use when Codex should create a brand-new image, transform an existing image, or derive visual variants from references, and the output should be a bitmap asset rather than repo-native code or vector. Do not use when the task is better handled by editing existing SVG/vector/code-native assets, extending an established icon or logo system, or building the visual directly in HTML/CSS/canvas. (file: r2/imagegen/SKILL.md)
- openai-docs: Use for Codex models/pricing, scheduled tasks, skills, settings, setup, troubleshooting, customization, automations, and self-knowledge—including 'you,' 'your,' 'this app,' or 'this coding agent' when they refer to Codex—and for OpenAI APIs/products and ChatGPT Work. Also use for model choice/migration, prompting, SDKs, Responses, Realtime, agents, evals, and Chat/Work/Codex comparisons. Do not use for generic app/software tasks that merely mention Codex. (file: r2/openai-docs/SKILL.md)
- plugin-creator: Create and scaffold plugin directories for Codex with a required `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`, optional plugin folders/files, valid manifest defaults, and personal-marketplace entries by default. Use when Codex needs to create a new personal plugin, add optional plugin structure, generate or update marketplace entries for plugin ordering and availability metadata, or update an existing local plugin during development with the CLI-driven cachebuster and reinstall flow. (file: r2/plugin-creator/SKILL.md)
- skill-creator: Create or update a Codex skill with appropriately scoped instructions and any needed supporting resources. (file: r2/skill-creator/SKILL.md)
- skill-installer: Install Codex skills into $CODEX_HOME/skills from a curated list or a GitHub repo path. Use when a user asks to list installable skills, install a curated skill, or install a skill from another repo (including private repos). (file: r2/skill-installer/SKILL.md)
- browser-use: Browser automation via browser-use CLI: navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, interact with web pages, web testing. (file: r1/browser-use/SKILL.md)
- browser:control-in-app-browser: Control the in-app Browser for opening, navigating, inspecting visible or interactive page state, clicking, typing, screenshots, and local web testing. It can have existing signed-in sessions. For semantic operations on linked resources, prefer a purpose-built connector, API, or CLI when available. (file: r3/browser/26.810.52044/skills/control-in-app-browser/SKILL.md)
- buddy: buddyctl CLI: observe the desktop, start/stop Buddy sessions, run session tools (pointer, keyboard, gestures, attention). For long-running Observe watching, also use buddy-observe. (file: r0/buddy/SKILL.md)
- claude-p-subagent: Delegate a task to Anthropic Claude Code via the `claude` CLI in non-interactive `-p/--print` mode (aka `claude -p`) and use the response as a sub-agent result. Use when you want a second opinion (review, alternatives, edge cases), quick summarization/translation, or structured JSON output via `--output-format json` / `--json-schema`, or when the user explicitly asks to “ask Claude / use claude -p / use Claude as a sub-agent”. (file: r0/claude-p-subagent/SKILL.md)
- clickhouse-ingest: Insert data into ClickHouse data warehouse: HTTP/native INSERT, bulk loading, agent session logs, app events. NOT for schema changes (use clickhouse-ops) or querying (use clickhouse-query). (file: r1/clickhouse-ingest/SKILL.md)
- clickhouse-ops: ClickHouse data warehouse on GPU server (192.168.10.4): Docker Compose, schema DDL, migrations, user admin, retention/TTL, server config. NOT for writing data (use clickhouse-ingest) or querying (use clickhouse-query). (file: r1/clickhouse-ops/SKILL.md)
- clickhouse-query: Query and analyze ClickHouse data warehouse: SELECT patterns, agent session analysis, app event analytics, materialized views, system introspection. NOT for schema changes (use clickhouse-ops) or data insertion (use clickhouse-ingest). (file: r1/clickhouse-query/SKILL.md)
- comfyui: ComfyUI on GPU server (192.168.10.4): image generation, inpainting, LoRA, checkpoints, custom nodes, workflow execution, diffusion workflows, data generation pipelines. (file: r1/comfyui/SKILL.md)
- computer-use:computer-use: Control local Mac apps through Computer Use for tasks that require reading or operating app UI. Prefer purpose-built connectors, APIs, or CLIs when available. (file: r3/computer-use/1.0.1000717/skills/computer-use/SKILL.md)
- documents:documents: Create, edit, redline, and comment on `.docx`, Word, and Google Docs-targeted document artifacts inside the container, with a strict render-and-verify workflow. Use `render_docx.py` to generate page PNGs (and optional PDF) for visual QA, then iterate until layout is flawless before delivering the final document. (file: r5/documents/26.813.12317/skills/documents/SKILL.md)
- fanza-doujin-db: FANZA同人データセットのJSON文書カタログ。作品・画像・画像＋モデルの属性、信頼性、根拠、Datasette検索、JSON Schemaと画像の取得に使う。 (file: r0/fanza-doujin-db/SKILL.md)
- find-docs: Retrieves authoritative, up-to-date technical documentation, API references, configuration details, and code examples for any developer technology. Use this skill whenever answering technical questions or writing code that interacts with external technologies. This includes libraries, frameworks, programming languages, SDKs, APIs, CLI tools, cloud services, infrastructure tools, and developer platforms. Common scenarios: - looking up API endpoints, classes, functions, or method parameters - checking configuration options or CLI commands - answering "how do I" technical questions - generating code that uses a specific library or service - debugging issues related to frameworks, SDKs, or APIs - retrieving setup instructions, examples, or migration guides - verifying version-specific behavior or breaking changes Prefer this skill whenever documentation accuracy matters or when model knowledge may be outdated. (file: r1/find-docs/SKILL.md)
- gal-advice: Use when the agent wants advice or a blunt second opinion. Run the gal command to get an outside perspective on the situation. (file: r0/gal-advice/SKILL.md)
- gpu-containers: Docker containers on GPU server (192.168.10.4): NVIDIA GPU workloads, Docker Compose, container management, service orchestration, image builds, CUDA deployment. (file: r1/gpu-containers/SKILL.md)

# AGENTS

This file is for agents to understand the context of the project.

## Project Goal

Implement a Zero Table Dependencies (ZTD) mechanism for PHP 8.1+ using a PDO Proxy.
The goal is to enable testing without modifying the physical database by using CTEs to shadow tables and simulate writes.

## Core Concepts

- **CTE Shadowing**: Using `WITH` clauses to mock table data for SELECT queries.
- **Result Select Query**: Converting INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE queries into SELECT queries that return the data that would have been modified.

## Tech Stack

- PHP 8.1+
- MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite
- PHPStan (Level Max)
- PHP-CS-Fixer
- PHPUnit
- Infection
- PHP-Fuzzer

## Coding Rule

- Follow the fix instructions provided in lint error messages

## Packages

### packages/ztd-query-core

Core library for ZTD Query. Provides the foundational interfaces, session management, and query routing logic.
Contains `Session`, query classification interfaces, rewriter contracts, and schema abstractions.
No platform-specific or adapter code — those live in separate packages.

### packages/ztd-query-mysql

MySQL platform support for ZTD Query. Handles SQL parsing, classification, rewriting, error classification, schema reflection, and mutation resolution using phpmyadmin/sql-parser.
Provides `MySqlSessionFactory` for creating ZTD sessions with MySQL support.
Depends on ztd-query-php core. Includes fuzz testing for robustness (classify, rewrite, full).

### packages/ztd-query-postgres

PostgreSQL platform support for ZTD Query. Handles SQL parsing, classification, rewriting, error classification, schema reflection, and mutation resolution.
Provides `PgSqlSessionFactory` for creating ZTD sessions with PostgreSQL support.
Depends on ztd-query-php core. Includes fuzz testing for robustness (classify, rewrite, full).

### packages/ztd-query-sqlite

SQLite platform support for ZTD Query. Handles SQL parsing, classification, rewriting, error classification, schema reflection, and mutation resolution.
Provides `SqliteSessionFactory` for creating ZTD sessions with SQLite support.
Depends on ztd-query-php core. Includes fuzz testing for robustness (classify, rewrite, full).

### packages/ztd-query-pdo-adapter

PDO adapter for ZTD Query. Provides `ZtdPdo` (extends PDO) and `ZtdPdoStatement` (extends PDOStatement) that transparently apply ZTD rewriting via delegation pattern.
Depends on ztd-query-php core and ztd-query-mysql. Integration tests use MySQL Testcontainers.

### packages/ztd-query-mysqli-adapter

MySQLi adapter for ZTD Query. Provides `ZtdMysqli` (extends mysqli) and `ZtdMysqliStatement` (extends mysqli_stmt) that transparently apply ZTD rewriting via delegation pattern.
Depends on ztd-query-php core and ztd-query-mysql. Integration tests use MySQL Testcontainers.

### packages/sql-faker

Faker Provider for generating syntactically valid SQL statements for MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQLite.
Based on official grammar definitions, can generate any statement type (DML, DDL, TCL, etc.) and SQL fragments (expressions, clauses, subqueries, CTEs).
Supports MySQL 5.6–9.1, PostgreSQL, and SQLite. Used for fuzz testing.

### packages/sql-fixture

Faker Provider for generating test fixture data from SQL schemas.
Parses CREATE TABLE statements and generates type-appropriate fake data using PHP-Faker.
Provides three usage modes: SQL string-based (`FixtureProvider`), PDO connection-based (`DatabaseFixtureProvider`), and DDL file directory-based (`FileFixtureProvider`).
Supports MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQLite. Includes object hydration via `ReflectionHydrator`. Used for fuzz testing and integration tests.

### packages/phpstan-custom-rules

Project-specific PHPStan rules package shared across ztd-query packages.
Provides custom rules for code quality and consistency, including forbidden comments (`@phpstan-ignore*`, `//`), restrictions in test classes (no properties/constants/private methods), and source/unit test pairing checks.
Loaded from each package `phpstan.neon` via `vendor/k-kinzal/phpstan-custom-rules/extension.neon`.

## Documents

- [docs/ztd-mechanism.md](docs/ztd-mechanism.md) - Overview and design of the ZTD mechanism
- [docs/mysql-spec.md](docs/mysql-spec.md) - How ZTD handles MySQL SQL statements
- [docs/postgres-spec.md](docs/postgres-spec.md) - How ZTD handles PostgreSQL SQL statements
- [docs/sqlite-spec.md](docs/sqlite-spec.md) - How ZTD handles SQLite SQL statements
- [docs/sql-support-matrix.md](docs/sql-support-matrix.md) - Supported SQL statements and their status

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Fuzz\Container;

use Override;
use Testcontainers\Containers\GenericContainer\GenericContainer;
use Testcontainers\Containers\WaitStrategy\PDO\MySQLDSN;
use Testcontainers\Containers\WaitStrategy\PDO\PDOConnectWaitStrategy;

/**
 * The my sql80 container.
 */
final class MySql80Container extends GenericContainer
{
    /**
     * @var null|string
     */
    protected static $IMAGE = 'mysql:8.0.44';

    /**
     * @var null|string
     */
    protected static $REUSE_MODE = 'reuse';

    /**
     * @var array<int>|null
     */
    protected static $EXPOSED_PORTS = [3306];

    /**
     * @var array<string, string>|null
     */
    protected static $ENVIRONMENTS = [
        'MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD' => 'root',
    ];

    /**
     * @var null|int
     */
    protected static $STARTUP_TIMEOUT = 300;

    #[Override]
    protected function waitStrategy($instance): PDOConnectWaitStrategy
    {
        unset($instance);

        return (new PDOConnectWaitStrategy())
            ->withDsn((new MySQLDSN())->withCharset('utf8mb4'))
            ->withUsername('root')
            ->withPassword('root')
            ->withTimeoutSeconds(120)
            ->withRetryInterval(250000);
    }

    /**
     * Answers grammar version.
     *
     * @return string
     */
    public static function getGrammarVersion(): string
    {
        return 'mysql-8.0.44';
    }
}
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Fuzz\Container;

use Override;
use Testcontainers\Containers\GenericContainer\GenericContainer;
use Testcontainers\Containers\WaitStrategy\LogMessageWaitStrategy;

/**
 * The postgre sql container.
 */
final class PostgreSqlContainer extends GenericContainer
{
    /**
     * @var null|string
     */
    protected static $IMAGE = 'postgres:16';

    /**
     * @var null|string
     */
    protected static $REUSE_MODE = 'reuse';

    /**
     * @var array<int>|null
     */
    protected static $EXPOSED_PORTS = [5432];

    /**
     * @var array<string, string>|null
     */
    protected static $ENVIRONMENTS = [
        'POSTGRES_USER' => 'test',
        'POSTGRES_PASSWORD' => 'test',
        'POSTGRES_DB' => 'fuzz_test',
    ];

    /**
     * @var null|int
     */
    protected static $STARTUP_TIMEOUT = 300;

    #[Override]
    protected function waitStrategy($instance): LogMessageWaitStrategy
    {
        unset($instance);

        return (new LogMessageWaitStrategy())
            ->withPattern('\\[1\\].*database system is ready to accept connections')
            ->withTimeoutSeconds(120);
    }
}
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Fuzz\Container;

use RuntimeException;
use Testcontainers\Testcontainers;

/**
 * Selects a disposable service supplied by CI or starts a local test container.
 */
final class DatabaseEndpoint
{
    /**
     * @return array{string, int}
     * @throws RuntimeException When the service port is invalid or unmapped.
     */
    public static function mysql(): array
    {
        $host = getenv('MYSQL_HOST');

Database container definitions were maintained separately in sql-faker, sql-fixture, and the PDO/MySQLi adapters. This includes `MYSQL_VERSION` selection for PDO and fresh MySQLi containers for each run. Package CI now watches the shared definitions, and the split workflow removes this monorepo-only development dependency from published manifests.

- sql-fixture unit suite passed with databases supplied by the shared containers.

    protected static $STARTUP_CONFLICT_RETRY_ATTEMPTS = 10;

    /**
     * @var bool|null
     */
    protected static $AUTO_REMOVE_ON_EXIT = true;

    /**
     * Select the MySQL version under test while retaining the standalone default.
     */
    public function __construct()
    {
        $version = getenv('MYSQL_VERSION');
        parent::__construct('mysql:' . ($version === false ? '8.0.44' : $version));
    }

    #[Override]
    protected function waitStrategy($instance): PDOConnectWaitStrategy
    {
        unset($instance);

        return (new PDOConnectWaitStrategy())
            ->withDsn((new MySQLDSN())->withCharset('utf8mb4'))
            ->withUsername('root')
            ->withPassword('root')
            ->withTimeoutSeconds(120)
            ->withRetryInterval(250000);
    }

    /**
     * After start.
     *
     */
    public function afterStart($instance): void
    {
        $port = $instance->getMappedPort(3306);
        $host = str_replace('localhost', '127.0.0.1', $instance->getHost());

        $pdo = new PDO(
            "mysql:host={$host};port={$port};charset=utf8mb4",
            'root',
            'root',
            [PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION, PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC]
        );

        $instance->setData($pdo);
    }

}

name: CI (container)

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'packages/container/**'
      - '.github/workflows/container.yml'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

defaults:
  run:
    working-directory: packages/container

jobs:
  test:
    name: Test (PHP ${{ matrix.php }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: ['8.1', '8.2', '8.3', '8.4', '8.5']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: mbstring, pdo_mysql, pdo_pgsql, mysqli
          coverage: none
      - uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3
        with:
          working-directory: packages/container
      - run: composer test:unit
      - run: composer test:integration

  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
          extensions: mbstring, pdo_mysql, pdo_pgsql, mysqli
          coverage: none
      - uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3
        with:
          working-directory: packages/container
      - run: composer lint

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Unit;

use Container\Pdo\MySqlContainer;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\CoversClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

#[CoversClass(MySqlContainer::class)]
final class MySqlContainerTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testDefaultsToPinnedVersionWithoutEnvironmentOverride(): void
    {
        $previous = getenv('MYSQL_VERSION');
        try {
            putenv('MYSQL_VERSION');
            self::assertSame('mysql:8.0.44', (new MySqlContainer())->image());
        } finally {
            putenv($previous === false ? 'MYSQL_VERSION' : 'MYSQL_VERSION=' . $previous);
        }
    }

    public function testVersionOverrideAppliesOnlyToNewInstances(): void
    {
        $previous = getenv('MYSQL_VERSION');
        try {
            putenv('MYSQL_VERSION=8.4.7');
            $mysql84 = new MySqlContainer();
            putenv('MYSQL_VERSION=8.0.44');
            $mysql80 = new MySqlContainer();

            self::assertSame('mysql:8.4.7', $mysql84->image());
            self::assertSame('mysql:8.0.44', $mysql80->image());
        } finally {
            putenv($previous === false ? 'MYSQL_VERSION' : 'MYSQL_VERSION=' . $previous);
        }
    }
}
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Integration;

use Container\Mysqli\MySql80Container;
use Container\Mysqli\MySql84Container;
use Container\Pdo\MySqlContainer;
use Container\Pdo\PostgreSqlContainer;
use mysqli;
use mysqli_result;
use PDO;
use PDOStatement;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\CoversClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use Testcontainers\Testcontainers;

#[CoversClass(MySqlContainer::class)]
#[CoversClass(MySql80Container::class)]
#[CoversClass(MySql84Container::class)]
#[CoversClass(PostgreSqlContainer::class)]
final class TestDatabaseTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testPdoMySqlReusesItsNativeConnection(): void
    {
        $instance = Testcontainers::run(MySqlContainer::class);
        $connection = $instance->getData(PDO::class);
        self::assertInstanceOf(PDO::class, $connection);
        $result = $connection->query('SELECT 1');
        self::assertInstanceOf(PDOStatement::class, $result);
        self::assertSame(1, $result->fetchColumn());
        self::assertSame($connection, Testcontainers::run(MySqlContainer::class)->getData(PDO::class));
    }

    public function testPostgreSqlReusesItsNativeConnection(): void
    {
        $instance = Testcontainers::run(PostgreSqlContainer::class);
        $connection = $instance->getData(PDO::class);
        self::assertInstanceOf(PDO::class, $connection);
        $result = $connection->query('SELECT current_database()');
        self::assertInstanceOf(PDOStatement::class, $result);
        self::assertSame('ztd_test', $result->fetchColumn());
        self::assertSame($connection, Testcontainers::run(PostgreSqlContainer::class)->getData(PDO::class));
    }

    public function testMysqli80InitializesItsTestDatabase(): void

runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php:
        - '8.1'
        - '8.2'
        - '8.3'
        - '8.4'
        - '8.5'
        mysql:
        - 8.0.44
        - 8.4.7
    env:
      MYSQL_VERSION: ${{ matrix.mysql }}
    steps:
    - name: Check out the repository
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
    - name: Set up PHP
      uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
      with:
        php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
        extensions: ctype, dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, pdo_mysql, pdo_pgsql, pdo_sqlite,
          phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
        coverage: none
        ini-values: memory_limit=512M
    - name: Validate Composer metadata
      run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
    - name: Install dependencies
      uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
      with:
        working-directory: packages/ztd-query-pdo-adapter
        dependency-versions: locked

# Database Containers

Shared Testcontainers definitions for integration and fuzz tests in this monorepo.
Requires PHP 8.1+, Docker, and the PDO driver for the database being started.
The MySQLi helper also requires `ext-mysqli`.

Add `k-kinzal/container: dev-main` to the consuming package's `require-dev` and
`{"type": "path", "url": "../container", "options": {"versions": {"k-kinzal/container": "dev-main"}}}` to its Composer repositories.
Run the container-dependent tests from this monorepo. This internal development dependency is removed when packages are split for publication.

## Definitions

The profiles preserve the existing images, credentials, database names, wait
strategies, and container lifecycle settings.

| Namespace | Definitions | Behavior |
|-----------|-------------|----------|
| `Container\Fuzz` | `MySql56Container`, `MySql57Container`, `MySql80Container`, `MySql81Container`, `MySql82Container`, `MySql83Container`, `MySql84Container`, `MySql90Container`, `MySql91Container`, `PostgreSqlContainer` | Pinned MySQL releases and PostgreSQL 17.2; disposable containers for SQL grammar fuzzing |
| `Container\Reusable` | `MySql80Container`, `MySql84Container`, `PostgreSqlContainer` | MySQL 8.0.44 / 8.4.7 and PostgreSQL 16; reused within an adapter fuzzing process |
| `Container\Fixture` | `MySql84Container` | MySQL 8.4.7 with the `test` database initialized |
| `Container\Pdo` | `MySqlContainer`, `PostgreSqlContainer` | MySQL 8.0.44 (overridable with `MYSQL_VERSION`) and PostgreSQL 16; cached PDO connections |
| `Container\Mysqli` | `MySql80Container`, `MySql84Container` | MySQL 8.0.44 / 8.4.7; fresh containers with a native MySQLi connection and an initialized `test` database |

MySQL containers use `root` / `root`. PostgreSQL containers use `test` / `test`,
with `fuzz_test` for fuzzing and `ztd_test` for integration tests.
PostgreSQL containers wait for the server readiness log message.

## Usage

```php
use Container\Fuzz\MySql80Container;
use Testcontainers\Testcontainers;

$instance = Testcontainers::run(MySql80Container::class);
$host = $instance->getHost();
$port = $instance->getMappedPort(3306);
$grammarVersion = MySql80Container::getGrammarVersion();
```

```php
use Container\Pdo\MySqlContainer;
use Testcontainers\Testcontainers;

$instance = Testcontainers::run(MySqlContainer::class);
$pdo = $instance->getData(PDO::class);
```

Use `Container\Mysqli\MySql80Container` or `MySql84Container` and
`$instance->getData(mysqli::class)` for a MySQLi connection. PDO containers are
reused within the process; MySQLi containers restart on each `run()` call.
Testcontainers stops the containers at process shutdown.

## Development

```bash
composer install
composer test:unit
composer test:integration
composer lint
```

Integration tests require Docker and `pdo_mysql`, `pdo_pgsql`, and `mysqli`.

Requires PHP 8.1+, Docker, and the PDO driver for the database being started.
The MySQLi helper also requires `ext-mysqli`.

Add `k-kinzal/container: dev-main` to the consuming package's `require-dev` and
`{"type": "path", "url": "../container", "options": {"versions": {"k-kinzal/container": "dev-main"}}}` to its Composer repositories.
Run the container-dependent tests from this monorepo. This internal development dependency is removed when packages are split for publication.

## Definitions

The profiles preserve the existing images, credentials, database names, wait
strategies, and container lifecycle settings.

| Namespace | Definitions | Behavior |
|-----------|-------------|----------|
| `Container\Fuzz` | `MySql56Container`, `MySql57Container`, `MySql80Container`, `MySql81Container`, `MySql82Container`, `MySql83Container`, `MySql84Container`, `MySql90Container`, `MySql91Container`, `PostgreSqlContainer` | Pinned MySQL releases and PostgreSQL 17.2; disposable containers for SQL grammar fuzzing |
| `Container\Reusable` | `MySql80Container`, `MySql84Container`, `PostgreSqlContainer` | MySQL 8.0.44 / 8.4.7 and PostgreSQL 16; reused within an adapter fuzzing process |
| `Container\Fixture` | `MySql84Container` | MySQL 8.4.7 with the `test` database initialized |
| `Container\Pdo` | `MySqlContainer`, `PostgreSqlContainer` | MySQL 8.0.44 (overridable with `MYSQL_VERSION`) and PostgreSQL 16; cached PDO connections |
| `Container\Mysqli` | `MySql80Container`, `MySql84Container` | MySQL 8.0.44 / 8.4.7; fresh containers with a native MySQLi connection and an initialized `test` database |

MySQL containers use `root` / `root`. PostgreSQL containers use `test` / `test`,
with `fuzz_test` for fuzzing and `ztd_test` for integration tests.
PostgreSQL containers wait for the server readiness log message.

## Usage

```php
use Container\Fuzz\MySql80Container;
use Testcontainers\Testcontainers;

$instance = Testcontainers::run(MySql80Container::class);
$host = $instance->getHost();
$port = $instance->getMappedPort(3306);
$grammarVersion = MySql80Container::getGrammarVersion();
```

```php
use Container\Pdo\MySqlContainer;
use Testcontainers\Testcontainers;

$instance = Testcontainers::run(MySqlContainer::class);
$pdo = $instance->getData(PDO::class);
```

Use `Container\Mysqli\MySql80Container` or `MySql84Container` and
`$instance->getData(mysqli::class)` for a MySQLi connection. PDO containers are
reused within the process; MySQLi containers restart on each `run()` call.
Testcontainers stops the containers at process shutdown.

## Development

```bash
composer install
composer test:unit
composer test:integration
composer lint
```

Integration tests require Docker and `pdo_mysql`, `pdo_pgsql`, and `mysqli`.

name: CI (container)

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'packages/container/**'
      - '.github/workflows/container.yml'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

defaults:
  run:
    working-directory: packages/container

jobs:
  test:
    name: Test (PHP ${{ matrix.php }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: ['8.1', '8.2', '8.3', '8.4', '8.5']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: mbstring, pdo_mysql, pdo_pgsql, mysqli
          coverage: none
      - uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3
        with:
          working-directory: packages/container
      - run: composer test:unit
      - run: composer test:integration

  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
          extensions: mbstring, pdo_mysql, pdo_pgsql, mysqli
          coverage: none
      - uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3
        with:
          working-directory: packages/container
      - run: composer lint
"}}

# Database Containers

Shared Testcontainers definitions for integration and fuzz tests in this monorepo.
Requires PHP 8.1+, Docker, and the PDO driver for the database being started.
The MySQLi helper also requires `ext-mysqli`.

Add `k-kinzal/container: dev-main` to the consuming package's `require-dev` and
`{"type": "path", "url": "../container", "options": {"versions": {"k-kinzal/container": "dev-main"}}}` to its Composer repositories.
Run the container-dependent tests from this monorepo. This internal development dependency is removed when packages are split for publication.

## Definitions

The profiles preserve the existing images, credentials, database names, wait
strategies, and container lifecycle settings.

| Namespace | Definitions | Behavior |
|-----------|-------------|----------|
| `Container\Fuzz` | `MySql56Container`, `MySql57Container`, `MySql80Container`, `MySql81Container`, `MySql82Container`, `MySql83Container`, `MySql84Container`, `MySql90Container`, `MySql91Container`, `PostgreSqlContainer` | Pinned MySQL releases and PostgreSQL 17.2; disposable containers for SQL grammar fuzzing |
| `Container\Reusable` | `MySql80Container`, `MySql84Container`, `PostgreSqlContainer` | MySQL 8.0.44 / 8.4.7 and PostgreSQL 16; reused within an adapter fuzzing process |
| `Container\Fixture` | `MySql84Container` | MySQL 8.4.7 with the `test` database initialized |
| `Container\Pdo` | `MySqlContainer`, `PostgreSqlContainer` | MySQL 8.0.44 (overridable with `MYSQL_VERSION`) and PostgreSQL 16; cached PDO connections |
| `Container\Mysqli` | `MySql80Container`, `MySql84Container` | MySQL 8.0.44 / 8.4.7; fresh containers with a native MySQLi connection and an initialized `test` database |

MySQL containers use `root` / `root`. PostgreSQL containers use `test` / `test`,
with `fuzz_test` for fuzzing and `ztd_test` for integration tests.
PostgreSQL containers wait for the server readiness log message.

## Usage

```php
use Container\Fuzz\MySql80Container;
use Testcontainers\Testcontainers;

$instance = Testcontainers::run(MySql80Container::class);
$host = $instance->getHost();
$port = $instance->getMappedPort(3306);
$grammarVersion = MySql80Container::getGrammarVersion();
```

```php
use Container\Pdo\MySqlContainer;
use Testcontainers\Testcontainers;

$instance = Testcontainers::run(MySqlContainer::class);
$pdo = $instance->getData(PDO::class);
```

Use `Container\Mysqli\MySql80Container` or `MySql84Container` and
`$instance->getData(mysqli::class)` for a MySQLi connection. PDO containers are
reused within the process; MySQLi containers restart on each `run()` call.
Testcontainers stops the containers at process shutdown.

## Development

```bash
composer install
composer test:unit
composer test:integration
composer lint
```

Integration tests require Docker and `pdo_mysql`, `pdo_pgsql`, and `mysqli`.

<INSTRUCTIONS>
<!-- NOTE: You do not have permission to overwrite this file. Please ask a human operator to perform the changes for you. -->
# AGENTS

This file is for agents to understand the context of the project.

## Project Goal

Implement a Zero Table Dependencies (ZTD) mechanism for PHP 8.1+ using a PDO Proxy.
The goal is to enable testing without modifying the physical database by using CTEs to shadow tables and simulate writes.

## Core Concepts

- **CTE Shadowing**: Using `WITH` clauses to mock table data for SELECT queries.
- **Result Select Query**: Converting INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE queries into SELECT queries that return the data that would have been modified.

## Tech Stack

- PHP 8.1+
- MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite
- PHPStan (Level Max)
- PHP-CS-Fixer
- PHPUnit
- Infection
- PHP-Fuzzer

## Coding Rule

- Follow the fix instructions provided in lint error messages

## Packages

### packages/ztd-query-core

Core library for ZTD Query. Provides the foundational interfaces, session management, and query routing logic.
Contains `Session`, query classification interfaces, rewriter contracts, and schema abstractions.
No platform-specific or adapter code — those live in separate packages.

### packages/ztd-query-mysql

MySQL platform support for ZTD Query. Handles SQL parsing, classification, rewriting, error classification, schema reflection, and mutation resolution using phpmyadmin/sql-parser.
Provides `MySqlSessionFactory` for creating ZTD sessions with MySQL support.
Depends on ztd-query-php core. Includes fuzz testing for robustness (classify, rewrite, full).

### packages/ztd-query-postgres

PostgreSQL platform support for ZTD Query. Handles SQL parsing, classification, rewriting, error classification, schema reflection, and mutation resolution.
Provides `PgSqlSessionFactory` for creating ZTD sessions with PostgreSQL support.
Depends on ztd-query-php core. Includes fuzz testing for robustness (classify, rewrite, full).

### packages/ztd-query-sqlite

SQLite platform support for ZTD Query. Handles SQL parsing, classification, rewriting, error classification, schema reflection, and mutation resolution.
Provides `SqliteSessionFactory` for creating ZTD sessions with SQLite support.
Depends on ztd-query-php core. Includes fuzz testing for robustness (classify, rewrite, full).

### packages/ztd-query-pdo-adapter

PDO adapter for ZTD Query. Provides `ZtdPdo` (extends PDO) and `ZtdPdoStatement` (extends PDOStatement) that transparently apply ZTD rewriting via delegation pattern.
Depends on ztd-query-php core and ztd-query-mysql. Integration tests use MySQL Testcontainers.

### packages/ztd-query-mysqli-adapter

MySQLi adapter for ZTD Query. Provides `ZtdMysqli` (extends mysqli) and `ZtdMysqliStatement` (extends mysqli_stmt) that transparently apply ZTD rewriting via delegation pattern.
Depends on ztd-query-php core and ztd-query-mysql. Integration tests use MySQL Testcontainers.

### packages/sql-faker

Faker Provider for generating syntactically valid SQL statements for MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQLite.
Based on official grammar definitions, can generate any statement type (DML, DDL, TCL, etc.) and SQL fragments (expressions, clauses, subqueries, CTEs).
Supports MySQL 5.6–9.1, PostgreSQL, and SQLite. Used for fuzz testing.

### packages/sql-fixture

Faker Provider for generating test fixture data from SQL schemas.
Parses CREATE TABLE statements and generates type-appropriate fake data using PHP-Faker.
Provides three usage modes: SQL string-based (`FixtureProvider`), PDO connection-based (`DatabaseFixtureProvider`), and DDL file directory-based (`FileFixtureProvider`).
Supports MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQLite. Includes object hydration via `ReflectionHydrator`. Used for fuzz testing and integration tests.

### packages/phpstan-custom-rules

Project-specific PHPStan rules package shared across ztd-query packages.
Provides custom rules for code quality and consistency, including forbidden comments (`@phpstan-ignore*`, `//`), restrictions in test classes (no properties/constants/private methods), and source/unit test pairing checks.
Loaded from each package `phpstan.neon` via `vendor/k-kinzal/phpstan-custom-rules/extension.neon`.

## Documents

- [docs/ztd-mechanism.md](docs/ztd-mechanism.md) - Overview and design of the ZTD mechanism
- [docs/mysql-spec.md](docs/mysql-spec.md) - How ZTD handles MySQL SQL statements
- [docs/postgres-spec.md](docs/postgres-spec.md) - How ZTD handles PostgreSQL SQL statements
- [docs/sqlite-spec.md](docs/sqlite-spec.md) - How ZTD handles SQLite SQL statements
- [docs/sql-support-matrix.md](docs/sql-support-matrix.md) - Supported SQL statements and their status

</INSTRUCTIONS>

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Integration;

use Container\MySql80Container;
use Container\MySql84Container;
use Container\MySqlContainer;
use Container\PostgreSql16Container;
use Container\PostgreSql17Container;
use Container\PostgreSqlContainer;
use mysqli;
use mysqli_result;
use PDO;
use PDOStatement;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\CoversClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use Testcontainers\Testcontainers;

#[CoversClass(MySqlContainer::class)]
#[CoversClass(PostgreSqlContainer::class)]
#[CoversClass(MySql80Container::class)]
#[CoversClass(MySql84Container::class)]
#[CoversClass(PostgreSql16Container::class)]
#[CoversClass(PostgreSql17Container::class)]
final class TestDatabaseTest extends TestCase
{
    /** @return iterable<string, array{class-string<MySqlContainer>}> */
    public static function mysqlVersions(): iterable
    {
        yield '8.0' => [MySql80Container::class];
        yield '8.4' => [MySql84Container::class];
    }

    /** @return iterable<string, array{class-string<PostgreSqlContainer>}> */
    public static function postgresVersions(): iterable
    {
        yield '16' => [PostgreSql16Container::class];
        yield '17' => [PostgreSql17Container::class];
    }

    /** @param class-string<MySqlContainer> $class */
    #[DataProvider('mysqlVersions')]
    public function testSameMySqlInstanceSupportsPdoAndMysqli(string $class): void
    {
        $instance = Testcontainers::run($class);
        $host = str_replace('localhost', '127.0.0.1', $instance->getHost());
        $port = $instance->getMappedPort(3306);
        self::assertNotNull($port);
        $pdo = new PDO("mysql:host=$host;port=$port;dbname=test;charset=utf8mb4", 'root', 'root', [PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION]);
        $mysqli = new mysqli($host, 'root', 'root', 'test', $port);
        $mysqli->set_charset('utf8mb4');
        $pdo->exec('CREATE TABLE shared_connection (id INT PRIMARY KEY)');
        $pdo->exec('INSERT INTO shared_connection VALUES (42)');
        $result = $mysqli->query('SELECT id FROM shared_connection');
        self::assertInstanceOf(mysqli_result::class, $result);
        self::assertSame(['42'], $result->fetch_row());
        self::assertSame($instance, Testcontainers::run($class));
        $pdo->exec('DROP TABLE shared_connection');
    }

    /** @param class-string<PostgreSqlContainer> $class */
    #[DataProvider('postgresVersions')]
    public function testPostgreSqlStartsWithTheCommonDatabase(string $class): void
    {
        $instance = Testcontainers::run($class);
        $host = str_replace('localhost', '127.0.0.1', $instance->getHost());
        $port = $instance->getMappedPort(5432);
        $pdo = new PDO("pgsql:host=$host;port=$port;dbname=test", 'test', 'test', [PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION]);
        $result = $pdo->query('SELECT current_database()');
        self::assertInstanceOf(PDOStatement::class, $result);
        self::assertSame('test', $result->fetchColumn());
        self::assertSame($instance, Testcontainers::run($class));
    }
}

name: CI (container)

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'packages/container/**'
      - '.github/workflows/container.yml'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

defaults:
  run:
    working-directory: packages/container

jobs:
  test:
    name: Test (PHP ${{ matrix.php }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: ['8.1', '8.2', '8.3', '8.4', '8.5']

jobs:

    name: Tests (PHP ${{ matrix.php }}, MySQL ${{ matrix.mysql }}, PostgreSQL 16, SQLite)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:

    - name: Set up PHP
      uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
      with:
        php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
        extensions: ctype, dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, pdo_mysql, pdo_pgsql, pdo_sqlite,
          phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
        coverage: none
        ini-values: memory_limit=512M
    - name: Validate Composer metadata
      run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
    - name: Install dependencies
      uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
      with:
        working-directory: packages/ztd-query-pdo-adapter
        dependency-versions: locked
        require-lock-file: true
        composer-options: --prefer-dist
    - name: Check installed platform requirements
      if: matrix.php == '8.1' || matrix.php == '8.2' || matrix.php == '8.3'
      run: composer check-platform-reqs
    - name: Check library requirements outside the locked ParaTest PHP range
      if: matrix.php == '8.4' || matrix.php == '8.5'
      run: composer check-platform-reqs --no-dev
    - name: Pull database images before timed tests
      run: |
        php <<'PHP'
        <?php
        require 'vendor/autoload.php';
        $mysql = getenv('MYSQL_VERSION') === '8.4.7' ? new Container\MySql84Container() : new Container\MySql80Container();
        foreach ([$mysql, new Container\PostgreSql16Container()] as $container) {
            passthru('docker pull ' . escapeshellarg($container->image()), $status);
            if ($status !== 0) {
                exit($status);
            }
        }
        PHP
    - name: Run PHPUnit and doctest with ParaTest
      run: composer test
  lint:
    name: Static checks
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

      with:
        working-directory: packages/ztd-query-pdo-adapter
        dependency-versions: locked
        require-lock-file: true
        composer-options: --prefer-dist
    - name: Check installed platform requirements
      run: composer check-platform-reqs
    - name: Check PSR-4 paths and ambiguous classes
      run: composer autoload:check
    - name: Check formatting
      run: composer format:check
    - name: Check source metrics
      run: composer loc-guard
    - name: Run PHPStan and toolkit rules
      run: composer phpstan
    - name: Check PHP compatibility
      run: composer compat
    - name: Check source tree
      run: composer tree-guard
    - name: Check architecture boundaries
      run: composer deptrac
  bench:
    name: Benchmark execution
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
    - name: Check out the repository
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1

        dependency-versions: locked
        require-lock-file: true
        composer-options: --prefer-dist
    - name: Check installed platform requirements

name: CI (ztd-query-pdo-adapter)
'on':
  push:
    branches:
    - main
  pull_request:
    paths:
    - packages/container/**
    - packages/ztd-query-pdo-adapter/**
    - packages/ztd-query-mysql/**
    - packages/ztd-query-postgres/**
    - packages/ztd-query-sqlite/**
    - packages/ztd-query-core/**
    - packages/sql-faker/**
    - packages/sql-fixture/**
    - .github/workflows/ztd-query-pdo-adapter.yml
  workflow_dispatch: null
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash
    working-directory: packages/ztd-query-pdo-adapter
jobs:
  test:
    name: Tests (PHP ${{ matrix.php }}, MySQL ${{ matrix.mysql }}, PostgreSQL 16, SQLite)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php:
        - '8.1'
        - '8.2'
        - '8.3'
        - '8.4'
        - '8.5'
        mysql:
        - 8.0.44
        - 8.4.7
    env:
      MYSQL_VERSION: ${{ matrix.mysql }}
    steps:
    - name: Check out the repository
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
    - name: Set up PHP
      uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
      with:
        php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
        extensions: ctype, dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, pdo_mysql, pdo_pgsql, pdo_sqlite,
          phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
        coverage: none
        ini-values: memory_limit=512M
    - name: Validate Composer metadata
      run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
    - name: Install dependencies
      uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
      with:
        working-directory: packages/ztd-query-pdo-adapter
        dependency-versions: locked
        require-lock-file: true
        composer-options: --prefer-dist
    - name: Check installed platform requirements
      if: matrix.php == '8.1' || matrix.php == '8.2' || matrix.php == '8.3'
      run: composer check-platform-reqs
    - name: Check library requirements outside the locked ParaTest PHP range
      if: matrix.php == '8.4' || matrix.php == '8.5'
      run: composer check-platform-reqs --no-dev
    - name: Pull database images before timed tests
      run: |
        php <<'PHP'
        <?php
        require 'vendor/autoload.php';
        $mysql = getenv('MYSQL_VERSION') === '8.4.7' ? new Container\MySql84Container() : new Container\MySql80Container();
        foreach ([$mysql, new Container\PostgreSql16Container()] as $container) {
            passthru('docker pull ' . escapeshellarg($container->image()), $status);
            if ($status !== 0) {
                exit($status);
            }
        }
        PHP
    - name: Run PHPUnit and doctest with ParaTest
      run: composer test
  lint:
    name: Static checks
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
    - name: Check out the repository
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
    - name: Set up PHP
      uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
      with:
        php-version: '8.3'
        extensions: ctype, dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, pdo_mysql, pdo_pgsql, pdo_sqlite,
          phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
        coverage: none
        ini-values: memory_limit=512M
    - name: Validate Composer metadata
      run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
    - name: Install dependencies
      uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
      with:
        working-directory: packages/ztd-query-pdo-adapter
        dependency-versions: locked
        require-lock-file: true
        composer-options: --prefer-dist
    - name: Check installed platform requirements
      run: composer check-platform-reqs
    - name: Check PSR-4 paths and ambiguous classes
      run: composer autoload:check
    - name: Check formatting
      run: composer format:check
    - name: Check source metrics
      run: composer loc-guard
    - name: Run PHPStan and toolkit rules
      run: composer phpstan
    - name: Check PHP compatibility
      run: composer compat
    - name: Check source tree
      run: composer tree-guard
    - name: Check architecture boundaries
      run: composer deptrac
  bench:
    name: Benchmark execution
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
    - name: Check out the repository
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
    - name: Set up PHP
      uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
      with:
        php-version: '8.3'
        extensions: ctype, dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, pdo_mysql, pdo_pgsql, pdo_sqlite,
          phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
        coverage: none
        ini-values: memory_limit=512M
    - name: Validate Composer metadata
      run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
    - name: Install dependencies
      uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
      with:
        working-directory: packages/ztd-query-pdo-adapter
        dependency-versions: locked
        require-lock-file: true
        composer-options: --prefer-dist
    - name: Check installed platform requirements
      run: composer check-platform-reqs
    - name: Run the benchmarks
      run: |
        mkdir -p build/phpbench
        composer run-script --timeout=1200 bench -- --dump-file=build/phpbench/results.xml | tee build/phpbench/report.txt
    - name: Upload benchmark measurements
      if: always()
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
      with:
        name: ztd-query-pdo-adapter-phpbench
        path: packages/ztd-query-pdo-adapter/build/phpbench/
        if-no-files-found: ignore

  mutation:
    name: Mutation Testing
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
    - name: Check out the repository
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0
    - name: Set up PHP
      uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
      with:
        php-version: '8.5'
        extensions: ctype, dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, pdo_mysql, pdo_pgsql, pdo_sqlite,
          phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
        coverage: pcov
        ini-values: memory_limit=512M
        tools: infection:0.35.4
    - name: Validate Composer metadata
      run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
    - name: Install dependencies
      uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
      with:
        working-directory: packages/ztd-query-pdo-adapter
        dependency-versions: locked
        require-lock-file: true
        composer-options: --prefer-dist
    - name: Check installed platform requirements
      run: composer check-platform-reqs --no-dev
    - name: Mutation testing on changed lines
      if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      run: php -d memory_limit=4G "$(command -v infection)" --configuration=infection.json5 --threads=4 --only-covering-test-cases --with-uncovered
        --git-diff-lines --git-diff-base="origin/${GITHUB_BASE_REF}" --ignore-msi-with-no-mutations --min-msi=85 --min-covered-msi=85
        --no-progress --logger-github
    - name: Mutation testing on the whole source tree
      if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
      run: php -d memory_limit=4G "$(command -v infection)" --configuration=infection.json5 --threads=4 --only-covering-test-cases --with-uncovered
        --no-progress --logger-github
    - name: Reject skipped whole-tree mutants
      if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
      run: |
        php -d memory_limit=4G -r '
          $report = json_decode(file_get_contents("build/infection/infection.json"), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
          if ($report["stats"]["skippedCount"] !== 0) {
              fwrite(STDERR, "Infection skipped mutants before execution; review the timeout against test durations.\n");
              exit(1);
          }
        '
    - name: Upload mutation reports
      if: always()
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
      with:
        name: pdo-infection
        path: packages/ztd-query-pdo-adapter/build/infection/
        if-no-files-found: ignore

import pathlib, subprocess
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
for name in ['container','sql-faker','sql-fixture','ztd-query-pdo-adapter','ztd-query-mysqli-adapter']:
    package=root/'packages'/name
    log=root/'build'/f'container-flat-{name}-setup.log'
    with log.open('w') as out:
        cmd=['composer','dump-autoload','--no-interaction'] if name=='container' else ['composer','update','k-kinzal/container','--no-interaction','--minimal-changes','--no-progress']
        result=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=package,stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        print(name,'autoload',result.returncode,flush=True)
        if result.returncode: continue
        paths=[p for p in subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','--diff-filter=AM','--',str(package)],text=True).splitlines() if p.endswith('.php')]
        paths += [p for p in subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard','--',str(package)],text=True).splitlines() if p.endswith('.php')]
        if paths:
            result=subprocess.run(['vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer','fix','--allow-risky=yes','--config=.php-cs-fixer.dist.php','--path-mode=intersection',*[str(root/p) for p in paths]],cwd=package,stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
            print(name,'format',result.returncode,flush=True)
PY

new file mode 100644
index 000000000..795b1bfb9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/container/README.md
@@ -0,0 +1,64 @@
+# Database Containers
+
+Shared database container definitions for PHP 8.1+ and Docker. Every consumer uses
+one definition per database version from the `Container` namespace.
+
+## Versions
+
+| Class | Image |
+|-------|-------|
+| `MySql56Container` | `mysql:5.6.51` |
+| `MySql57Container` | `mysql:5.7.44` |
+| `MySql80Container` | `mysql:8.0.44` |
+| `MySql81Container` | `mysql:8.1.0` |
+| `MySql82Container` | `mysql:8.2.0` |
+| `MySql83Container` | `mysql:8.3.0` |
+| `MySql84Container` | `container-registry.oracle.com/mysql/community-server:8.4.7` |
+| `MySql90Container` | `container-registry.oracle.com/mysql/community-server:9.0.1` |
+| `MySql91Container` | `container-registry.oracle.com/mysql/community-server:9.1.0` |
+| `PostgreSql16Container` | `postgres:16` |
+| `PostgreSql17Container` | `postgres:17.2` |
+
+All containers initialize the `test` database. MySQL uses `root` / `root` and
+PostgreSQL uses `test` / `test`. MySQL data is stored in tmpfs, and timezone table
+loading is disabled to keep startup fast. Running the same class reuses its
+container until it is stopped; containers are removed when stopped.
+
+`MySqlContainer` and `PostgreSqlContainer` are abstract bases for the shared
+settings. Connection creation, database/schema isolation, and version selection
+belong to the caller. MySQL classes expose `getGrammarVersion()` for SQL grammar
+selection.
+
+## Usage
+
+Add `k-kinzal/container: dev-main` to the consuming package's `require-dev` and
+`{"type": "path", "url": "../container", "options": {"versions": {"k-kinzal/container": "dev-main"}}}`
+to its Composer repositories. This internal development dependency is removed
+when packages are split for publication.
+
+```php
+use Container\MySql80Container;
+use Testcontainers\Testcontainers;
+
+$instance = Testcontainers::run(MySql80Container::class);
+$host = str_replace('localhost', '127.0.0.1', $instance->getHost());
+$port = $instance->getMappedPort(3306);
+$pdo = new PDO("mysql:host=$host;port=$port;dbname=test;charset=utf8mb4", 'root', 'root');
+$mysqli = new mysqli($host, 'root', 'root', 'test', $port);
+$mysqli->set_charset('utf8mb4');
+```
+
+MySQL readiness checks require `pdo_mysql`. PostgreSQL waits for the server's
+readiness log message. Install the appropriate PHP driver for the connections
+used by your code.
+
+## Development
+
+```bash
+composer install
+composer test:unit
+composer test:integration
+composer lint
+```
+
+Integration tests require Docker and `pdo_mysql`, `pdo_pgsql`, and `mysqli`.
